about.title: About Us
about.intro: BEST4IMG is a free collection of fast, private, and approachable image tools.

sections.title: What we build
paragraphs: We provide compression, resizing, cropping, conversion, watermark, GIF, and creative image tools in one focused workspace.

sections.title: Local first
paragraphs: Most image processing runs on your device with browser technologies such as Canvas, WebAssembly, and Web Workers. Your images are not intentionally uploaded to our servers to perform these operations.

sections.title: Our principles
paragraphs: We favor clear controls, predictable output, and sensible performance. We add features when they are genuinely useful and suitable for local processing.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using BEST4IMG, you agree to these terms. Keep an original copy of important files before processing them.

sections.title: Scope of service
paragraphs: BEST4IMG provides browser-based image processing tools as available. Features, supported formats, and processing limits may change as the product is updated.

sections.title: Your responsibilities
paragraphs: You must have the right to process and use the images you select. You must not use the service to infringe copyright, privacy, or other lawful rights, or attempt to disrupt the website or other people’s use of it.

sections.title: Image rights and permission to process
paragraphs: Your rights in the original images do not transfer to BEST4IMG when you use these tools. We do not acquire ownership of your images, nor do we require permission to use them for public display or model training.

Adding a watermark, cropping, or converting a file does not grant you new rights in someone else’s work. Obtain any necessary permission when an image contains a person’s likeness, trademarks, protected works, or personal information.

sections.title: Files and device limitations
paragraphs: Files are processed in your browser. Speed and capacity depend on your device memory, browser, and image complexity. Individual tools may set limits on file count, file size, or dimensions.

Refreshing the page, closing the tab, or a browser failure may remove results that have not been downloaded. The website is not a file storage or backup service. Keep your originals and download any results you need to your own device.

sections.title: Results and availability
paragraphs: Image encoders, browser implementations, and device resources differ. We do not guarantee that every file will process successfully or that an output will suit a particular printing, archival, or professional purpose. Check downloaded results before deleting an original.

sections.title: Formats, color, and specialized requirements
paragraphs: Lossy compression and re-encoding may change detail, color, transparency, or metadata. JPG does not support transparency, and processed animations may have palette differences. Quality descriptions on the site do not mean every operation is lossless.

Size presets and portrait guides for avatars and ID photos assist with layout but are not certified by any platform or receiving authority. Before submitting an image, check the recipient’s current requirements for dimensions, background, composition, and file limits.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, BEST4IMG is not liable for lost files, output differences, service interruptions, or indirect losses arising from use of the service or its results.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms when features or legal requirements change. Updated terms will be published on this page with a new revision date.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: BEST4IMG uses a local-first approach. This policy explains how images and basic technical information are handled.

sections.title: Image processing
paragraphs: Images you select are normally read and processed within the current browser tab. They are not intentionally uploaded to our servers to run image tools.

sections.title: Temporary browser data
paragraphs: The site may create previews, results, and temporary object URLs in memory, and may store necessary preferences such as language locally in your browser.

sections.title: Basic technical information
paragraphs: Hosting infrastructure may record request times, URLs, browser types, network addresses, and error logs for security and reliability. These logs do not contain images processed locally.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: You can stop processing, close the page, or clear locally stored site data through your browser settings at any time.

seo.title: BEST4IMG | Local Image Compressor for JPG, PNG, WebP, and SVG
seo.description: Compress JPG, PNG, WebP, and SVG images directly in your browser. BEST4IMG keeps files local, handles batches, and reduces size without obvious quality loss.

heicConverter.heroSubtitle: Convert Apple HEIC photos locally in your browser
heicConverter.dropTitle: Drop or Select your HEIC images

hero.title:
Convert HEIC to JPG
Locally, Instantly, Privately
hero.subtitle: No sign-up, no server upload, no file size restrictions imposed by a backend. Everything runs inside your browser using WebAssembly-powered decoding.

featureCards.title: Fully Private — Nothing Leaves Your Device
featureCards.body: HEIC decoding and JPG encoding all happen in your browser tab. Your photos never touch a remote server, which makes this safe for personal memories, medical images, and confidential files.

featureCards.title: Batch Conversion with a Sequential Queue
featureCards.body: Drop up to 50 HEIC files at once and each one is processed in order. A controlled queue prevents the browser from freezing even when handling large, multi-megapixel HEIC photos from an iPhone or iPad.

featureCards.title: Full Resolution Output
featureCards.body: The converted JPG preserves the original pixel dimensions. No downscaling, no hidden resampling. What you shot is what you get — just in a format that every app, browser, and device can open.

underHood.title: The technical layer behind the HEIC conversion pipeline.

cards.title: heic2any with WebAssembly Decoding
cards.body: HEIC files use Apple's HEIF container with HEVC (H.265) encoding. The heic2any library runs a WebAssembly-compiled decoder entirely in the browser to turn that proprietary format into standard image data without needing a native OS call.

cards.title: Single-File Sequential Processing
cards.body: HEIC decoding is significantly more CPU-intensive than decoding PNG or JPEG. Processing files one at a time avoids saturating the main thread and keeps the page responsive while your batch is being converted.

JPG, PNG, WebP, and SVG
hero.subtitle: Make images smaller for websites, documents, stores, and sharing without making them look obviously worse.

featureCards.title: Flawless Details & Transparent Edges
featureCards.body: Ever compressed a software screenshot or a transparent PNG, only to see blurry text and rough white edges? BEST4IMG leans toward UI elements, captions, and logos so files get dramatically smaller without making important details fall apart.

featureCards.title: 100% Local & Secure
featureCards.body: Your files stay with you. Compression runs entirely in your browser, so nothing gets uploaded to a remote server. That makes it a much safer fit for internal assets, personal photos, and sensitive materials.

autopilot.title: Intelligent Optimization, Without Guesswork
autopilot.body: Use the 90% default for a balanced result, or set the quality and maximum file size when you need tighter control. BEST4IMG still keeps the image looking natural while aiming for a smaller file.

underHood.title: The technical layer behind the compression pipeline.

cards.title: Edge-Aware PNG Quantization
cards.body: PNG images go through a tuned libimagequant WebAssembly path that tries to preserve high-frequency edges more carefully, helping icons, transparent assets, and UI graphics stay cleaner at smaller sizes.

cards.title: More Conservative JPEG Handling for UI-like Images
cards.body: When an image looks more like interface graphics or mixed text-and-image content, the JPEG path becomes more conservative so small text and sharp edges are less likely to break down.

cards.title: Worker-Side Decode with OffscreenCanvas
cards.body: Image decoding and pixel extraction run inside a Web Worker via OffscreenCanvas, which helps reduce main-thread stalls when large images are being processed.

cards.title: Size Guard and Fallback Logic
cards.body: If a supposedly compressed result ends up larger, BEST4IMG avoids blindly returning it. The pipeline falls back to a safer path and can return the original when needed.
